page.overview:
Who is Spike?

Spike, also known as Spike the Dragon, is a male dragon and one of the seven main characters of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. He is Twilight Sparkle's best friend and number one assistant; as a dragon, he uses his magic fire breath to transfer scrolls to and from Princess Celestia.

Spike is referred to as a "baby" dragon in several episodes and other media, though in 2018, co-director Jim Miller indicated that the character was by then "more like a pre-teen". In the season eight episode Molt Down, Spike gains a pair of wings after undergoing a developmental stage for dragons called the "molt".

In the Generation 5 My Little Pony: Make Your Mark episode The Isle of Scaly, Spike reappears as a fully grown dragon and the current Dragon Lord after spending centuries in magical hibernation.__TOC__

Spike's appearance is based on his Generation 1 incarnation more than his Generation 3 version, with a few modifications done by Lauren Faust. In G1, he was portrayed as a baby dragon with green spikes, and his body was pink. In his G3 incarnation, he was a 1,000-year old dragon with orange spikes, purple hair, and a blue body. He and Applejack are the only main characters to be taken from G1.
